                                                                                                                        
 Usage: danvas assignments update [OPTIONS] SOURCE                                                                      
                                                                                                                        
 Plan one assignment update from Markdown; use --apply to write Canvas.                                                 
                                                                                                                        
 Plan or update one assignment resolved by stable identity.                                                             
                                                                                                                        
╭─ Arguments ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ *    source      PATH  Markdown source with assignment_id/canvas_id front matter, source-map entry, or               │
│                        --assignment-id.                                                                              │
│                        [required]                                                                                    │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --course-id                 INTEGER         Canvas course ID.                                                        │
│ --assignment-id             INTEGER         Canvas assignment ID to update.                                          │
│ --match-title                               Resolve by exact Canvas assignment title only when no ID is available.   │
│ --dry-run                                   Plan without changing Canvas (also the default).                         │
│ --apply                                     Apply the planned change to Canvas.                                      │
│ --project-root              PATH            Course project root containing .danvas. [default: .]                     │
│ --asset-folder              TEXT            Existing Canvas Files folder for local assets.                           │
│ --asset-folder-id           INTEGER         Existing Canvas Files folder ID for local assets.                        │
│ --asset-on-duplicate        [error|rename]  Local-asset duplicate behavior. [default: error]                         │
│ --no-report                                 Suppress the default report run.                                         │
│ --report-root               PATH            Root for a dated report run directory.                                   │
│ --report-dir                PATH            Exact report run directory to create.                                    │
│ --report-slug               TEXT            Override the report run slug.                                            │
│ --profile                   TEXT            User-level Canvas instance profile from the danvas platform config.      │
│ --api-url                   TEXT            Canvas base URL. Overrides project and profile configuration;            │
│                                             CANVAS_API_URL is the final fallback.                                    │
│ --api-key-env               TEXT            Name of the environment variable containing the Canvas API token.        │
│ --api-key-file              PATH            Absolute path to a single-purpose file containing the Canvas API token.  │
│ --help                                      Show this message and exit.                                              │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
                                                                                                                        
 Effect:                                                                                                                
 Reads Canvas and can change Canvas only with --apply. Omission or --dry-run produces a plan. The workflow can affect   
 grades. The workflow can affect notifications or visibility.                                                           
 Privacy:                                                                                                               
 Retained output is course-internal and is not automatically safe to publish.                                           
 Resolution:                                                                                                            
 Uses the explicit target ID, source front matter, or project source-map provenance.                                    
 Typical sequence:                                                                                                      
 danvas assignments update SOURCE                                                                                       
 danvas assignments update SOURCE --apply                                                                               
 Verification:                                                                                                          
 Applied or compared state is checked against authoritative evidence.                                                   
 Safety guards:                                                                                                         
 Omission plans; --apply alone authorizes Canvas mutation.                                                              
 Failure boundary:                                                                                                      
 Inspect the retained plan/result evidence before deciding what to do next.                                             
 Refresh current Canvas state and generate a new plan before applying again.                                            
 Related:                                                                                                               
 danvas assignments verify
